title: Low balance alert
summary: Check your Paystack balance regularly and tell the owner when it drops below a level you set.
description: Every few hours, checks your Paystack naira balance and, when it is below the amount you set, tells the owner so payouts do not fail for lack of funds. The owner hears on the WhatsApp or Telegram they linked to Taskiem, or by email.

params.name: threshold
params.title: Alert below (naira)
params.description: Text the owner when the balance is below this many naira.

params.name: every_hours
params.title: Check every (hours)
params.description: How often to check, in hours.

params.name: paystack_connection
params.title: Paystack connection
params.description: The name of your Paystack connection.

steps.name: Tell the owner that the balance is low

input.message: ='Low balance: Paystack holds NGN ' + string(double(steps.balance.output.balances.filter(b, b.currency == 'NGN')[0].balance) / 100.0) + ', below your alert level of NGN ' + string(double({{threshold:kobo}}) / 100.0) + '. Top up to keep payouts running.'
